reason: It correctly uses that m=(p-1)/2 is odd. In the forward direction it proves both (-a)^m=1 and that every exponent annihilating -a is divisible by m. Conversely, a^m=-1 and a^{2m}=1; any a^n=1 forces m|n, and writing n=qm then forces q even, so every such n is divisible by 2m. Hence ord_p(a)=2m=p-1.
